profile.summary: Hello, my name is Trinity Williams and I am a recent graduate from LeMoyne-Owen College. I graduated with a BS, but have anyways been interested in coding frame-works. I am fascinated by the progress technology is making and enjoy learning new frameworks such as CSS, HTML, JavaScript, React, and React.Js. I pride myself on being curious, communicative, and result-driven. I prefer to work in team setting while cultivating long-lasting business and professional relationships.
